notes.title: Spooky Night’s Business Model: Free, Fair, and Built for Fun
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We want to take a moment to talk openly about the business model behind [b]Spooky Night[/b]—what it is, why we chose it, and how it benefits both you as a player and us as developers.

[h2]🎮 Free to Play, Truly[/h2]

At its core, [b]Spooky Night[/b] is [b]completely free to play[/b]. Not "free-to-try", not "free-but-pay-to-win"—just free. All features are unlocked for everyone. Whether you're playing casually with friends or diving deep into social deduction strategy, you won’t miss out on any gameplay functionality because you didn’t pay.

We believe everyone should be able to enjoy [b]Spooky Night[/b] equally.

[h2]💎 Rewards for Every Player[/h2]

Every player earns [b]gold[/b] and receives [b]a free skin[/b] at the end of each match. You don't have to spend anything to personalize your character or enjoy the rewards system. Skins are randomly awarded, and you will gradually build up your collection just by playing.

The [b]free tier[/b] allows you to store up to [b]700 skins[/b]. That’s more than enough for even the most fashion-forward werewolves out there!

[h2]🧛‍♂️ VIP Tiers[/h2]

We do offer two VIP tiers for players who want to support the game and get a little more in return—without making the game unfair or pay-to-win.

[h3]🥈 VIP Tier #1[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Costs $6[/b] (One-Time Purchase)
[*] Get [b]two random skins[/b] after every match
[*] Earn [b]more gold[/b] per game
[*] [b]Unlimited inventory space[/b] for skins
[/list]

[h3]🥇 VIP Tier #2[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Costs $10[/b] (One-Time Purchase, Requires Tier #1)
[*] Get [b]three random skins[/b] after every match
[*] Earn [b]even more gold[/b]
[/list]

These tiers are designed to [b]reward support[/b], not lock features behind a paywall. They’re simple, honest, and permanent—no subscriptions, no time limits, no hidden micro-transactions.

[h2]🤝 Why This Model?[/h2]

We chose this model because we believe it’s [b]player-friendly and sustainable[/b]. Here’s what we’re aiming for:

[list]
[*][b]Fairness[/b]: No pay-to-win mechanics. Everyone plays on the same level.
[*][b]Gratitude[/b]: Free players are part of this game’s lifeblood. We reward your time, not your wallet.
[*][b]Support[/b]: Paid tiers help us continue improving the game, adding new roles, skins, events, and features—all without compromising fairness.
[*][b]Transparency[/b]: No traps. No predatory pricing. What you see is what you get.
[/list]

[h2]💬 Final Thoughts[/h2]

We’re a small, passionate team. Every dollar earned from VIP purchases goes directly into making [b]Spooky Night[/b] better—for all players. Whether you’re a free player or a VIP, you're part of our haunted little village, and we’re thankful you're here.

If you enjoy [i]Spooky Night[/i], tell your friends, join our @[url=https://discord.gg/HH8RFT68DZ]Discord[/url], and leave a review. That kind of support means the world to us.

Thanks for playing—and stay spooky!

[b]—The Spooky Night Development Team[/b]

notes.title: Spooky Night Update – V1.0.1 ☠️⚡
notes.content:
Greetings, mortals! Fate has been watching, and the realm of Spooky Night has been imbued with new updates! Here’s what has changed in your haunted village:

🛠️ Gameplay Improvements

[list]
[*]     Fixed a bug where canceling votes was only allowed on valid targets.
[*]     The VIP Button is now hidden until its time comes.
[*]     Mouse Navigation through the village is now enabled by default.
[*]     A player's name turns red when they are eliminated—marked by fate himself.
[*]     Fixed a bug where voting was disabled in the last 5 seconds of the tutorial’s day phase.
[*]     Wolf Role Conflict Mechanic – If two wolves pick different targets, a conflict will now arise.
[*]     Fixed reward duplication at the end of a match—no more extra treats from the afterlife.
[*]     Win Conditions & Objectives are now clearly displayed at the start of the game and each phase.
[*]     Whisper Ability Removed – No more silent plotting… for now.
[/list]

🎭 Storytelling Enhancements

[list]
[*]     Lynch Event Revamp – A dramatic zoom-in, control lock, and role reveal amplify the tension!
[*]     Bite Event Improvements – More intense zoom-in, control lock, and role reveal. The attacked villager is now revealed during the day.
[*]     Wolf Reveal Improved – Wolves will now be unmasked in a far more compelling way at the end of the game.
[/list]

💬 UI & Visual Tweaks

[list]
[*]     Chat Icon Visibility – Clearly see whether you're speaking as a villager, a wolf, or among the dead.
[*]     Timer Enhancements – It now blinks red and plays a ticking sound when time is about to expire.
[*]     Role Icon Updates – Role icons now appear next to player names, in the shop, and in character customization.
[/list]

🖥️ Quality of Life Fixes

[list]
[*]     Fixed Main Menu Avatar Zoom – Your spooky faces are now properly displayed.
[*]     Credits Links Fixed – No more broken pathways to the great beyond.
[*]     Escape Button Works on Popups – Now you can exit popups (and the game) with ease.
[*]     Popup Skull Replacements – The skulls have been replaced with a clear ❌ mark.
[*]     Game Start Notifications – The game now grabs your attention by focusing your window when a match begins.
[/list]

⚡ The Grim Reaper is pleased with these changes. Play wisely, or be struck down by fate! ☠️⚡
